ck_mn_matter_node_time_shape.name: ck_mn_matter_node_time_shape
ck_mn_matter_node_time_shape.value:
(time_type = 'range' AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time >= start_time)
            OR (time_type = 'point' AND end_time IS NULL)
            OR (start_time IS NULL AND end_time IS NULL)

ck_mn_matter_node_cancel_reason.name: ck_mn_matter_node_cancel_reason
ck_mn_matter_node_cancel_reason.value: status <> 'cancelled' OR cancel_reason IS NOT NULL

ck_mn_party_id_type.name: ck_mn_party_id_type
ck_mn_party_id_type.value: id_type IS NULL OR id_type IN ('id_card','unified_social_credit','passport','hk_mo_tw_permit','military_id','foreign_residence','other')

ck_mn_party_merged_shape.name: ck_mn_party_merged_shape
ck_mn_party_merged_shape.value: merged_into_id IS NULL OR (merged_into_id <> id AND is_deleted)

ck_mn_risk_matter_source.name: ck_mn_risk_matter_source
ck_mn_risk_matter_source.value: source IS NULL OR source IN ('business_report','external_dispute','customer_complaint','lawyer_letter','internal_check','other')

ck_mn_risk_matter_node_time_shape.name: ck_mn_risk_matter_node_time_shape
ck_mn_risk_matter_node_time_shape.value:
(time_type = 'range' AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time >= start_time)
            OR (time_type = 'point' AND end_time IS NULL)
            OR (start_time IS NULL AND end_time IS NULL)

ck_mn_risk_matter_node_cancel_reason.name: ck_mn_risk_matter_node_cancel_reason
ck_mn_risk_matter_node_cancel_reason.value: status <> 'cancelled' OR cancel_reason IS NOT NULL

ck_mn_activity_host.name: ck_mn_activity_host
ck_mn_activity_host.value: matter_id IS NOT NULL OR risk_matter_id IS NOT NULL OR target_type = 'app_user'

ck_mn_attachment_category.name: ck_mn_attachment_category
ck_mn_attachment_category.value: category IS NULL OR category IN ('evidence','complaint','judgment','contract','internal_doc','other')
